title: Unbounded derived section cohomology presheaf on a scheme
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $i\in\mathbf Z$ define $\mathcal P_f^i:D(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O_Y)$ by $\mathcal P_f^i(E)(V)=H^i(R\Gamma(f^{-1}V,E))$, with its $\mathcal O_Y(V)$-module structure induced by $f$ and restriction maps induced by section restriction. Equivalently, derive the composite of the module direct image underlying [def-pc-derived-direct-image] with the inclusion of module sheaves into module presheaves, and take degree-$i$ cohomology in the presheaf category. On a K-injective representative $I$ of $E$, this is $V\mapsto H^i(\Gamma(f^{-1}V,I))$, with the same restriction maps; morphisms are induced by maps of K-injective representatives.
